items.title: Live: Canavan says he would not have accepted trip after Hanson declaration
items.description: Matt Canavan says he would not have accepted a trip to Europe from a benefactor after Pauline Hanson declared Gina Rinehart paid for her trip to Italy. Follow live.

items.title: Live: Search for survivors after Japan earthquake collapses shopping centre
items.description: Authorities are scouring the wreckage of a collapsed shopping centre southern Japan following a magnitude-7.1 earthquake. Follow live.

items.title: 'Australia's Banksy' rape case witness wants the courts to hear this
items.description: A woman who accused street artist Anthony Lister of rape is speaking up to help others navigate the police and court systems. Lister was acquitted of all charges last year.

items.title: Trump airs frustration with Netanyahu before Oval Office meeting
items.description: In the latest sign of shaky relations between the war-entangled leaders, Donald Trump uses a TV interview to publicly express his frustration with Benjamin Netanyahu's apparent efforts to pressure him to keep attacking Iran.

items.title: Ben Carroll begins first full day as Victorian premier
items.description: Victoria's new premier Ben Carroll will spend most of his first full day as state leader in Spring Street, with the Victorian Parliament in the middle of a sitting week.

items.title: Underbelly of Victoria's Big Build to be exposed by royal commission
items.description: After toppling his boss yesterday, new Victorian Premier Ben Carroll used his first press conference to tell voters who he is not.

items.title: Angus Taylor likes to talk about systems. People are his 'kryptonite'
items.description: In an interview for Kitchen Cabinet, the opposition leader recalls feeling a sense of overwhelm and reverence for the parliament when first he took his seat there.

items.title: 'They are getting fooled': How ultra-processed food is made to look healthier
items.description: Industry insiders reveal how Australians are being deceived by marketing and labelling that makes ultra-processed foods appear healthier than they really are.

items.title: Home loan borrowers missing out on millions in offset savings
items.description: The corporate regulator has found Australian banks paid more than $55 million in compensation over a two year period for failing to properly apply mortgage offsets.

items.title: Live: National records tumble as Aussie sprinters storm to 100m medals
items.description: Lachlan Kennedy and Torrie Lewis set new national records in claiming 100m medals, while a host of Australians take gold across athletics and swimming. Follow live.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
